About this item

  • Choose Between WiFi or Non-wifi Connections to Check on Baby Anywhere, Anytime: Use the dedicated BM04 baby monitor parent unit for reliable monitoring at home, or check the live feed via the Momcozy app while you're on the go. Advanced encryption ensures your baby monitor video is private and secure, so you can focus on your little one with peace of mind. Note: Pairing via Wi-Fi supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks.
  • Danger Zone Alert for Added Safety: Stay one step ahead with instant app notifications when your baby leaves a designated safe area. With this wifi baby monitor, you'll be alerted immediately so you can respond and keep them safe without delay.
  • Smart Motion Detection for Extra Assurance: Real-time motion alerts via APP notify you of your baby's movements, including potential dangers like a covered face or face-down sleeping. This baby video monitor keeps you informed and confident your baby is safe. (Motion Alerts Notifications Appear Only in the APP)
  • Shared Video Access to Enhance Family Bonds: Bring loved ones closer by sharing video access with up to 20 family members. With the baby monitor camera, they can watch your baby grow and celebrate milestones, even from afar.
  • Auto Video Recording for Precious Memories: Never miss a moment! The video monitor baby camera offers continuous or motion-activated recording to capture every milestone. With just a tap or press, you can also take photos or record videos manually using the baby monitor with app.
  • TIPS: Smart Baby Monitor Installation Guidelines: 1) Crib Mounting Height Requirement: Ensure the camera is positioned at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the baby. If placed too low, the camera’s focal length may misalign, causing a blurry image. 2) Wall or Floor Stand Mounting Distance Limit: Keep the camera within 5m (16 feet) of the crib horizontally. Beyond this range, the infrared night vision won’t provide sufficient lighting, making it difficult to see the baby’s face clearly in the dark.
  • NOTE: The Momcozy BM04 Smart Baby Monitor is certified by the FCC, and the reports can be publicly accessed on the FCC website (Monitor No: 2A6UA-BM04-A, Camera No: 2A6UA-BM04-B).

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

Customers say

Customers find the baby monitor easy to set up and use, with clear daytime video quality and an accessible phone app. The connectivity and reliability receive mixed feedback - while some report no connection issues, others experience constant disconnections and random failures. The sound quality and battery life also get mixed reviews, with some praising the sound detection while others report poor sound pickup, and some noting good battery life while others mention overnight battery death. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it worth the price and those who consider it not worth the cost.

    Was skeptical by the reviews but it was everything I needed.

    This camera has 2 great features that I need: one it comes with a video monitor I can use at home and the picture quality is really good even at night. It also can be used via the mom cozy app to view baby while away. Both my husband and I have access to the camera app and you can add multiple users.

    I like that it can be used with or without WiFi.

    I also discovered that if you plug a power bank onto the camera it works perfectly without being tied obligated to use a long cord and wall plug. You can buy different extensions from third parties to hook onto a crib, stroller or just for the bedroom

    It also has extra feature like talking back to your baby and playing music and motion detection. Sound quality is really good, it was easy to set up. Overall it was a well with it purchase

  • Sarah Wojnar
    1 out of 5 stars
    negative reviews have merritt…monitor is garbage WITH AN UPDATE
    Reviewed in the United States on May 18, 2026
    Set name: BM04 with 1 Camera
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    EDIT: My original review was one star and I was beyond disappointed in the product. We had some of the same issues that some of the other comments have listed. One night it officially stopped working. It turned off and the camera would not connect. I was LIVID. Once I got the monitor back on, I had to reconnect it to the camera. I pressed the pair button located on the back and it broke...... guys. IT BROKE. The long as short of it all: I sent MomCozy an email directly. it was not a kind email as I was very upset about this monitor failing me in the middle of the night. I don’t consider myself a very anxiety ridden person and didn't struggle much with it postpartum, but not having a baby monitor that works stressed me out to the max. Luckily and I am beyond thankful. MomCozy responded within hours and after a few back an forths about what was broken, some proof of it not working (a video of me pressing the button and it not pairing), they shipped me a new one in like 2 days. By the time I bought a temp camera and monitor, the new MomCozy one came in. Since then, I have actually had ZERO problems. They did state they were aware of the issues and it was supposed to be resolved in an upcoming software update. The new monitor we have had for about 2 months now and literally none of the issues have come back up. Even the time is correct. I really wanted to like the camera when I bought it as I adore the brand and have a lot of other products in their ecosystem. Plus it's a great camera quality! But I was so disappointed when I started having all these issues. I would still be weary, they helped me with a free replacement and I am happy with it so far! Leaving as a one star so people can see the good, the bad and the ugly of this product

    So disappointed. I haven’t even had this product for a full 2 months. Within the last couple of weeks started using the monitor full time as we transitioned my baby into his crib full time. The first few weeks we had no issues, other than the time being off. It always states it’s an hour behind. No matter how many times I manually adjust it. Otherwise is was so reliable and gave me peace of mind as the sound detection was very accurate and sensitive.

    However the last several days, all of the negative reviews under this monitor started proving true. Not only was the time wrong but the temperature detection was wrong. Constantly showing the room is 32°F even though the house is set to 68°F and I have the temp detection on for anything less than 67°F in his room. The sound/cry detection stopped working. This bothers me more than I can put into words. Woke up to the sound of my baby hysterically crying for who knows how long because the monitor never alerted me to sound in the room. The screen remained black and I had to manually hit the power button to wake the monitor before any sound came through. The monitor used to alert me if he sneezed or even grunted a little to loud. Now it won’t even go off if my baby is crying at the top of his lungs. On top of that, it constantly looses connectivity even when it’s within feet of the router. The lag is really frustrating considering the cost of the camera. I have restarted it and reset both the monitor and the camera and nothing fixes it. I have spent hours trying to troubleshoot and fix or reconnect the monitor. The app works just fine and the camera itself is great quality, but the monitor which is the piece that needs to be the most reliable, is garbage. For what this monitor costs, this is a major disappointment. As a FTM I adore other Momcozy items but this camera is beyond ridiculous. After spending several days researching cameras and landing on this one due to it matching my whole ecosystem of baby/mom products, this is infuriating. Do not waste your time and spare yourself the midnight panic when you’re baby is screaming their head off because the monitor you trusted to work suddenly stops working in the middle of the night.

  • C. Block
    5 out of 5 stars
    Not just for babies. Excellent product
    Reviewed in the United States on December 21, 2025
    Set name: BM04 with 1 Camera
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I have a slightly different use case. I don’t have a kid but a 72 year old sister with dementia who lives in my house. When I go out for longer than a couple hrs I can let her caregiver know and she will open up the app and check in on her so I can have some time off. I have other cameras as well but this one is excellent. My caregiver, from her home, opens the app and can monitor my sis and run over if there is a problem. Heck, even a sibling back east can log in and check in on her.

    I had no problem setting it up. The app is easy to use (though baby-centric but that’s ok), and the quality of the pic is excellent. You can pan/tilt the camera as well so I have great vision of the house and her usual sitting places. I’ve just ordered another camera for a different part of the house. I can see this camera being used to check on a parent, a new puppy, etc.

    My only critique is that I couldn’t find anywhere if there is a size limit for the memory card. If you want to pay back video you have to have a memory card inserted in to the camera. Else it’s just real time. The app works on iPhone and iPad. The monitor that comes with it is also excellent. And the night vision, like other reviews, is excellent. I’m super impressed. Highly recommend this product.

  • Steven Marion
    3 out of 5 stars
    Good When it Works
    Reviewed in the United States on September 16, 2026
    Set name: BM04 with 1 Camera
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    There are some great features with this camera - the monitor is a nice size, it both lights up and makes sound when it registers noise, and it's nice to be able to play white noise from it (though it only lasts a half hour, so not a full sleep cycle).

    That all being said, I would never get this again. I don't know if ours is defective, but 1-2 times a month, sometimes more, the monitor will randomly disconnect from the camera. This has happened a couple of times at night. Thank goodness our room isn't far from the baby room and I heard her, but I was still worried how long she'd been crying. It's also had a few odd instances where it wouldn't notify us of sound (and the room temperature would be way off). The light would usually be enough to wake me, but still not comforting. We'd have to reset the camera itself.

    So not the most reliable, and I would look into other options if I were to buy a new one.

  • Megan Reynolds
    4 out of 5 stars
    Overall we are pleased, but there are some glitches
    Reviewed in the United States on June 8, 2026
    Set name: BM04 with 1 Camera
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    While we have overall enjoyed this monitor, there are a few glitches that are frustrating. (Just for reference, we’ve been using the product for about 7 months now.)

    -It has been helpful to have a handheld screen to see video, as well as access to the app where you can watch the feed on your phone. However, I recently started having some issues with being able to access it via my phone. All of a sudden, the video would not show up, and even after troubleshooting we were not able to get it to work. Thankfully, though, we have the handheld monitor so we can still use that to see our baby in his room. It just makes it a little inconvenient because the monitor is one more thing I have to carry from room to room without the video on my phone.

    -The battery on the monitor is pretty good. If I take it off the charger in the morning around 8 am, it usually lasts until later in the afternoon at which time it gives a low battery signal. As long as it has charged for a few hours, we are usually able to keep it unplugged overnight as well if needed.

    -One recent issue that started in the past month is that the monitor will just go to a blank white screen out of nowhere, and then you have to restart it to get the picture to come back on.

    -We did have some difficulty finding the right angle to place the camera when we initially installed it, and we would have liked to have been able to just sit it on a shelf in order to be able to take it down easily for travel. But that angle did not work in the bedroom with the amount the camera would adjust. Thankfully, my husband was eventually able to screw it into a spot that gave us a good view of the entire crib.

  • Mommy2Be
    5 out of 5 stars
    Super clear visibility
    Reviewed in the United States on May 21, 2026
    Set name: BM04 with 1 Camera
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    We just got this set up yesterday. I really wanted one that had an actual monitor, not just phone app connection. This momcozy camera has both! I wanted the monitor to use at home, so I don’t have to have the app open on my phone 24/7 because I like to scroll videos on TikTok n stuff. But I also did very much want access to the camera from my phone as well for when we’re not home! It was very easy to set up. Pet self explanatory. Plug in the camera, download the momcozy app, hit add device & follow the steps. Only took about 5 minutes, if that!

    One thing that is annoying is the sound alerts. The camera is verrrrrry sensitive. The alarm went off on my monitor all night, just from my fiance walking down the hallway past the baby’s room, or when we flushed the toilet in the bathroom that is down the hall! Like wth is that?!? It doesn’t just listen for baby cries, it alerts for any sound. I have to figure out if they have a setting to fix that. I’m sure they have to, right?

    Well besides that, this is a great camera system for a great low price! Highly recommend!

About this Item

  • Choose Between WiFi or Non-wifi Connections to Check on Baby Anywhere, Anytime: Use the dedicated BM04 baby monitor parent unit for reliable monitoring at home, or check the live feed via the Momcozy app while you're on the go. Advanced encryption ensures your baby monitor video is private and secure, so you can focus on your little one with peace of mind. Note: Pairing via Wi-Fi supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks.
  • Danger Zone Alert for Added Safety: Stay one step ahead with instant app notifications when your baby leaves a designated safe area. With this wifi baby monitor, you'll be alerted immediately so you can respond and keep them safe without delay.
  • Smart Motion Detection for Extra Assurance: Real-time motion alerts via APP notify you of your baby's movements, including potential dangers like a covered face or face-down sleeping. This baby video monitor keeps you informed and confident your baby is safe. (Motion Alerts Notifications Appear Only in the APP)
  • Shared Video Access to Enhance Family Bonds: Bring loved ones closer by sharing video access with up to 20 family members. With the baby monitor camera, they can watch your baby grow and celebrate milestones, even from afar.
  • Auto Video Recording for Precious Memories: Never miss a moment! The video monitor baby camera offers continuous or motion-activated recording to capture every milestone. With just a tap or press, you can also take photos or record videos manually using the baby monitor with app.
  • TIPS: Smart Baby Monitor Installation Guidelines: 1) Crib Mounting Height Requirement: Ensure the camera is positioned at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the baby. If placed too low, the camera’s focal length may misalign, causing a blurry image. 2) Wall or Floor Stand Mounting Distance Limit: Keep the camera within 5m (16 feet) of the crib horizontally. Beyond this range, the infrared night vision won’t provide sufficient lighting, making it difficult to see the baby’s face clearly in the dark.
  • NOTE: The Momcozy BM04 Smart Baby Monitor is certified by the FCC, and the reports can be publicly accessed on the FCC website (Monitor No: 2A6UA-BM04-A, Camera No: 2A6UA-BM04-B).
